name: United States
blurb: The world’s largest and most prestigious higher-education market, with unmatched research and career reach, but the priciest option here and no clear route from study to a green card.

name: United Kingdom
blurb: Fast three-year degrees and world-famous universities, with a two-year Graduate Route to work, though settlement is slow and student-visa rules keep tightening.

name: Canada
blurb: Welcoming and English-speaking with one of the clearest routes from study to permanent residence, now recalibrating after 2024 to 2025 study-permit caps.
